App Manual Source Log in (( • )) ROGERAI · American AI research + infrastructure Tune in to the world’s decentralized Models . In under 30 seconds. RogerAI provides private inference networks for the edge, that means you and your homelab, that means factories and their fleet. Our labs focus on enabling open models to run on a spectrum of hardware . Our network runs one OpenAI-compatible local endpoint only you have access to, in a privatized relay on top of community and private hardware. It handles discovery, routing, failover, metering, and signed receipts. RogerAI is an AI company based in Orange County, California, building American research and infrastructure. PRODUCT The radio for Local Models One OpenAI-compatible endpoint for developers and teams, over community and private hardware; operators keep control of their machines - sharing a model never shares your files or your machine ( what a requester can reach → ). Set a call-sign, a rate, and your hours. Flip the switch. You are on air. roger share qwen3.8-27b --rate 0.30 tune in Use a model Pick a band, set your margins (max price, min speed). RogerAI locks the strongest station and hands you a local OpenAI endpoint + key. When one fades, it re-tunes. roger use qwen3.8-27b --max-price 0.30 --min-tps 40 §5 / SPECIFICATIONS the whole instrument, one plate Protocol OpenAI-compatible drop-in Transport Outbound long-poll no inbound ports Endpoint 127.0.0.1 local, key-scoped Pricing Per token operator-set, from free, $/1M Settlement Wallet balance debited live Lineage ed25519 co-signed ◆ weights, shard, token Split 90 / 10 operator's favor Curated list + 10% » marked, split on the receipt Relay split 90 / 5 / 5 station / tower / platform Interfaces Terminal + browser one store, two windows Reach Only the model port no shell, no files, no context Platforms macOS · Linux · Windows Apple Silicon: MLX and GGUF Backends vLLM · llama.cpp · Ollama · LM Studio · Osaurus · LiteLLM · any OpenAI-compatible §6 / THE INDUSTRIAL SERIES We wrote the book on this. Then we wrote the next one. Two field books for people who own machines: what a small local model can honestly do on a plant floor, and the physics of running one on hardware you already paid for. Written by machines, put through the press's three-pass review, verified by Roger AI, and free to read in full. Published by o’ailly press , a machine-first imprint. The whole catalogue ships with its review trail attached. Nº 1 Local LLMs for Manufacturing read it free → Nº 2 Inference on the Edge read it free → §7 / MONETIZE Two kinds of transmitter. One dial. Your GPU. Set a rate and keep 90% of every token you serve - or run open for free, plenty of stations broadcast for the love of the band. Your contracts. Already paying for API capacity? Put the contract on the air as a curated station . Consumers pay the list price plus 10%; you get your bill back in full, plus half the fee. The » mark tells everyone what it is, and the receipt shows the split. Same wallet, same payout as a GPU - the policy is short and printed in full. + Per-input and per-output pricing, per model + Time-of-use windows and usage caps you control + Provably fair metering, no under-reporting, no over-charging FIG. 4 - OPERATOR PANEL @you ◆ ILLUSTRATIVE model qwen3.8-27b rate $0.30 / 1M out volume 10M - 30M out / day uptime 50% your share 90% illustrative / day $1.35 - $4.05 rate × volume × uptime × share example assumptions · demand and earnings are not guaranteed §8 / PRIVACY-FIRST AIRWAVES The provider hears a station. Never you. A callsign, not a name Whoever answers hears a callsign and a job. Not your name, not your card, not your IP. Nothing ever knocks Stations dial out. No open port, no inbound path, no door to knock on. The honest limit Your words still reach the machine that answers. Too much? A confidential station or your own Tower . Carry, don’t compute No GPU? A Tower relays sealed work and keeps 5% of everything it carries. Raise a Tower → The exit is built in Run it standalone : your own private network, free, and it never phones home. A network you can leave has to earn your staying. Sometimes, go direct Steady volume to one vendor is cheaper direct - do it. What you’d leave behind sits next to the prices → §9 / GO Start with one command. You are installing roger : one binary, a local harness for local models . It finds the models already on your machine, puts them on air if you want, and tunes you into everyone else’s. $ curl -fsSL https://rogerai.fm/install.sh | sh On Windows (PowerShell): irm https://rogerai.fm/install.ps1 | iex Then pick your window. Both drive the same station, the same wallet and the same settings - a limit set in one is the limit the other enforces. The dial roger The terminal radio: browse the band, tune a station, chat, run the agent, put your own models on air. The console roger webui The same radio in a browser tab, with room for tables - sort the band, compare stations, and edit prices and caps on a full-width surface.
